PAGE 1
Abstract
Retrieval-augmented generation fetches documents at inference time and grounds the answer in those documents.
1 Introduction
A retriever selects passages and the generator conditions on those passages when answering a question.
PAGE 2
2 Experiments
The model reduces unsupported claims when the cited passage overlaps the answer text in the paper.
